final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT st.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS t, AVG(e.imgcount) AS i FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY st.entrystat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(i) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.entrystat, s1.t, s1.i, s1.i - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL
